open_items: Partial data contract only: the caller must supply a trusted prior work value; accepting that value from the same untrusted package is not authentication. Complete command-specific plan coverage and actual completion evidence, consistent snapshots, guarded work storage/locks, atomic publication, true resume, bounded whole-store memory and global finalization remain open. No Code 8, write authority, release approval or complete requirement satisfaction is claimed.

oracle.requirement_contract: Der vollständige gebundene Auftrag MUSS bei jeder Aufteilung unverändert als offene beziehungsweise nachgewiesen erledigte Arbeit erhalten bleiben.
oracle.scope: Initial data-only codec preserves the complete finite plan declared by a trusted caller across candidate partitions: stable Work-ID, task/input binding, exact disjoint completed/remaining membership and retained immutable original bytes. Completion evidence is declared JSON fixture data, not proof that a production handler actually executed. No persisted checkpoint, actual resume or final execution success is claimed. R adds an immediate-successor reader anchored in a caller-trusted prior manifest. It requires unchanged work/command/source/tool/task binding, exactly the next generation, additional declared completion, unchanged earlier evidence and all prior object bytes. Self-consistent replacement packages, replay, skipped generations, lost completions and JSON boolean substitutions are rejected. C relocates identical closed data and request-binding definitions and shares the same pure phase expressions between reader and writer. Existing W/R behavior, test identities, typed refusals, partial status and open boundaries are unchanged.

preconditions: Owned temporary source files and explicit fixture build/source declarations. Completion JSON is labelled planner data; one entropy test substitutes deterministic bytes. No production command is executed or durable work state published.
steps: Create a candidate from real owned input bytes and a complete declared finite unit plan.
Partition units in a different order and verify stable identity, exact remaining work and all prior bytes after each roundtrip.
Reject duplicate declarations or completion records; exercise segmented plans through 4097 units and detached values.

Exercise the R successor and hostile-data cases with independently rehashed packages, explicit planner fixtures and handler/foreign-object traps; require unchanged prior data and no execution or writes.
